title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior is adopted and maintained in a population under social influence, policies, information signals, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence_person_to_person
interactions.description: During social contacts, people observe peers’ mask use and attitudes; this updates their attitude_toward_masks and probability of wearing a mask.

interactions.name: attendance_and_contact_formation
interactions.description: People attend venues based on daily routine; venues mediate contact rates that drive social influence and potential policy enforcement.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_at_venues
interactions.description: Venues with mandates enforce mask use; noncompliant people may comply temporarily or incur penalties depending on enforcement_strength.

interactions.name: policy_broadcast
interactions.description: PolicyMaker issues mandates or recommendations and communicates messages that directly influence risk perception and attitudes.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: InformationEnvironment updates risk_signal (e.g., case rates) and broadcasts news/misinformation affecting risk perception and attitudes.

interactions.name: mask_acquisition
interactions.description: People attempt to purchase or acquire masks; success depends on inventory, price, and economic_cost_sensitivity.

interactions.name: household_norms_influence
interactions.description: Household norms shape member attitudes and mask-wearing habits.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing a mask on each day.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate over the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach the specified target adoption threshold.

metrics.name: adoption_by_venue_type
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing rate observed in each venue type.

metrics.name: policy_impact_on_adoption
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate before vs. after policy mandates or campaigns.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_post_policy
metrics.description: Adoption rate measured after mandates are lifted, indicating behavioral persistence.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across socioeconomic or demographic groups (e.g., difference or Gini across groups).

metrics.name: mask_access_gap
metrics.description: Proportion of people who intend to wear a mask but lack access/inventory.

metrics.name: mask_type_distribution
metrics.description: Distribution of mask types (cloth, surgical, N95) among mask wearers.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of enforcement actions or penalties issued at venues.
